title: tracegamma: the trace-gamma calibrated reference for quadratic-form tests (Python and R)
description: Python and R implementations of the trace-gamma distribution: the closed-form shifted, scaled chi-square matched to the first three cumulants of a quadratic form in near-normal variables. Welch's F is its two-cumulant member and Pearson's chi-square its equal-eigenvalue member. Also provides the exact generalized chi-square by Imhof inversion, the kurtosis and tail-rate defects, and an estimable non-normal correction. The two implementations are checked against each other by a shared parity fixture.
